query: Add this paper: <a DOI with an abstract in OpenAlex, not in the reading log>.
expected_behavior: Greps the reading log for the DOI
Writes a reading log entry with DOI, a citekey like smith2020, and no Zotero field

query: Add this paper: <a DOI with no abstract anywhere>.
Add the paper with DOI <a DOI already in the library>.
expected_behavior: Finds the existing item by DOI
Creates no new item. The top-level item count is unchanged

query: Run a review round on <a topic with no relevant literature>.
expected_behavior: Agrees on a plan with sub-questions and waits for go
Says plainly that nothing relevant was found and adds no padding papers
